projection.basis: Page 23 reproduces the dated September 2013 El Born Centre Cultural visitor diagram as an undistorted top-down schematic. Its vector paths separately encode the public-space fill, four named rooms, three archaeological-site panels, entrance arrows and room borders.

transform: translation only, equal x/y units; floor stacking is display-only
review: The 8 September 2013 Presencia page was inspected at native PDF vector resolution. Its El Born Centre Cultural diagram and 1-7 legend match the search-indexed official planol-catala.pdf graphic, whose legacy official URL now redirects instead of returning PDF bytes. This pinned republication is historical visitor evidence, not a current measured architectural survey. Exact PDF path bounds provide the public-space and room faces; red outline paths remain flat detail. Printed identifiers remain semantic labels and are not included in geometry.
